Jena: kicking off engine-v3.16-quantpatch-2026-05-14 to night-bucket. tiny canary 4% for 20m. pin TTL=1800s. release notes: https://gist.local/rw/engine-v3.16
Omar: which quant profile + matmul kernel?
Jena: q6_mixed with matmul-v2-opt. build tag q6mv2-20260514-rc1. fallback to engine-v3.15-compatible.
Priya: add immediate smoke gate after first 60 requests: p95 latency <130ms, p90 mem <75%, error-rate <1.3x baseline. if fail -> rollback + pin.
Marta: also exclude long-context routes (>4096 tokens) from canary for first 30m.
deploy-bot: [deploy] starting rollout id=rb-7412345678-01 -> night-bucket (canary 4%)
deploy-bot: pinned=false ttl=1800s
Omar: observability runbook ops/runbooks/engine-canary.yaml tagged. paging @oncall-marta for thresholds.
Marta: oncall here. paste the exact smoke queries and I'll monitor.
Jena: smoke queries:
```
latency.p95(filter:bucket=night)
memory.p90(filter:hostgroup=engine-night)
errors.rate(1m)
```
Reply with "rollback" in-thread if triggered.
deploy-bot: [smoke] initial n=88 samples: p95=112ms, mem p90=61%, err=0.12%  within thresholds :thumbsup:
Priya: plan to scale 4% -> 20% @t+8m, -> 60% @t+16m, full @t+20m if stable. immediate drain to 0% on rollback and pin previous bundle engine-v3.15-hotfix.
Jena: adding trace header x-quant-sample to capture warm-starts. posting a short customer note for Dedicated teams about transient perf variance during rollout.
Marta: observed a small GC bump at t+6m p99=240ms; not over our GC rollback criterion (250ms) yet. monitoring.
Omar: good. keep thread updated. if "rollback" is posted deploy-bot will act.
